content.body:
Update on this:

* Stack traces now properly handle outlining
* Stepping also handles inlining / outlining to a certain degree. E.g. stepping out of an inlined function body won't step too far and stepping over a statement that was outlihned will actually pause in the outlined function, etc.
* WASM also works (see example 8 in the examples page), except expression evaluation

We'll probably enable the experiment by default for Chrome 159 :)
